title: Hitting time for Hamilton cycles in pseudorandom graphs
summary: Consider the random subgraph process on a base graph $G$ with $n$ vertices: we generate a sequence $\{G_t\}_{t=0}^{|E(G)|}$ by taking a uniformly random ordering of the edges of $G$ and then adding these edges one by one to the empty graph $G_0$ on the same vertex set. We prove that there is a constant $C > 0$ such that if $G$ is an $(n,d,λ)$-graph with $d/λ\ge C$, then with high probability, the hitting time for the appearance of a Hamilton cycle coincides with the hitting time for reaching minimum degree $2$.
